title: Level 4 – Reasoning, experiences, and natural expression

items.sentence: 我對呢件事有唔同嘅睇法。
items.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 tai2 faat3
items.meaning: I have a different view on this matter.

items.sentence: 每個人嘅睇法都未必一樣。
items.jyutping: mui5 go3 jan4 ge3 tai2 faat3 dou1 mei6 bit1 jat1 joeng6
items.meaning: Everyone’s viewpoint isn’t necessarily the same.

items.sentence: 佢對工作嘅態度好認真。
items.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 zok3 ge3 taai3 dou6 hou2 jing6 zan1
items.meaning: He has a very serious attitude toward work.

items.sentence: 你嘅態度會影響結果。
items.jyutping: nei5 ge3 taai3 dou6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 git3 gwo2
items.meaning: Your attitude will affect the outcome.

items.sentence: 感覺上呢個地方冇之前咁熱鬧。
items.jyutping: gam2 gok3 soeng6 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 mou5 zi1 cin4 gam3 jit6 naau6
items.meaning: From how it feels, this place isn’t as lively as before.
items.sourceWordMeaning: from a feeling standpoint / in terms of feeling

items.sentence: 感覺上佢對呢件事唔太關心。
items.jyutping: gam2 gok3 soeng6 keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 m4 taai3 gwaan1 sam1
items.meaning: It feels like he isn’t very concerned about this matter.
items.sourceWordMeaning: from a feeling standpoint / in terms of feeling

items.sentence: 我哋喺呢個問題上立場好清楚。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 soeng6 lap6 coeng4 hou2 cing1 co2
items.meaning: Our stance on this issue is very clear.

items.sentence: 佢改變咗自己嘅立場。
items.jyutping: keoi5 goi2 bin3 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 lap6 coeng4
items.meaning: He changed his stance.

items.sentence: 從你嘅角度嚟睇，呢個決定好合理。
items.jyutping: cung4 nei5 ge3 gok3 dou6 lei4 tai2, ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hou2 hap6 lei5.
items.meaning: From your perspective, this decision is very reasonable.

items.sentence: 我哋可以用唔同角度去分析呢件事。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jung6 m4 tung4 gok3 dou6 heoi3 fan1 sik1 ni1 gin6 si6.
items.meaning: We can analyse this matter from different angles.

items.sentence: 你可唔可以幫我解釋呢個問題？
items.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 gaai2 sik1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4?
items.meaning: Can you help me explain this problem?

items.sentence: 老師用咗好多例子去解釋文法規則。
items.jyutping: lou5 si1 jung6 zo2 hou2 do1 lai6 zi2 heoi3 gaai2 sik1 man4 faat3 kwai1 zak1.
items.meaning: The teacher used many examples to explain the grammar rules.

items.sentence: 我嘗試解釋，但佢似乎未明白。
items.jyutping: ngo5 soeng4 si3 gaai2 sik1, daan6 keoi5 ci5 fu1 mei6 ming4 baak6.
items.meaning: I tried to explain, but he seems not to understand.

items.sentence: 請你詳細解釋下呢個概念。
items.jyutping: cing2 nei5 coeng4 sai2 gaai2 sik1 haa5 ni1 go3 koi3 nim6.
items.meaning: Please explain this concept in detail.

items.sentence: 我好難理解點解佢會噉做。
items.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 naan4 lei5 gaai2 dim2 gaai2 keoi5 wui5 gam2 zou6.
items.meaning: I find it hard to understand why he would do that.

items.sentence: 老師講解得好清楚，我完全理解咗。
items.jyutping: lou5 si1 gong2 gaai2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2, ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 lei5 gaai2 zo2.
items.meaning: The teacher explained clearly, and I completely understood.

items.sentence: 你試下換個角度去理解佢嘅感受。
items.jyutping: nei5 si3 haa5 wun6 go3 gok3 dou6 heoi3 lei5 gaai2 keoi5 ge3 gam2 sau6.
items.meaning: Try to understand his feelings from a different perspective.

items.sentence: 理解別人的立場，有助於溝通。
items.jyutping: lei5 gaai2 bit6 jan4 dik1 lap6 coeng4, jau5 zo6 jyu1 kau1 tung1.
items.meaning: Understanding others’ positions helps with communication.

items.sentence: 根據現有資料，我哋可以推斷事情嘅發展方向。
items.jyutping: gan1 geoi3 jin6 jau5 zi1 liu2, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 teoi1 dyun6 si6 cing4 ge3 faat3 zin2 fong1 hoeng3
items.meaning: Based on the available information, we can infer the direction of the situation.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to infer / to deduce / to draw a conclusion

items.sentence: 佢從對方嘅反應推斷結果未必樂觀。
items.jyutping: keoi5 cung4 deoi3 fong1 ge3 faan2 jing3 teoi1 dyun6 git3 gwo2 mei6 bit1 lok6 gun1
items.meaning: He inferred from the other person’s reaction that the outcome might not be optimistic.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to infer / to deduce / to draw a conclusion

items.sentence: 好難單憑外表去判斷一個人。
items.jyutping: hou2 naan4 daan1 pang4 ngoi6 biu2 heoi3 pun3 dyun6 jat1 go3 jan4
items.meaning: It’s hard to judge a person based solely on appearance.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to judge / to assess / to make a judgment

items.sentence: 我哋要根據事實嚟判斷問題。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gan1 geoi3 si6 sat6 lei4 pun3 dyun6 man6 tai4
items.meaning: We need to judge the issue based on the facts.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to judge / to assess / to make a judgment

items.sentence: 佢有好多工作經驗。
items.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 hou2 do1 gung1 zok3 ging1 jim6
items.meaning: He has a lot of work experience.

items.sentence: 呢次經驗令我學到好多嘢。
items.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ging1 jim6 ling6 ngo5 hok6 dou3 hou2 do1 je5
items.meaning: This experience taught me a lot.

items.sentence: 呢段回憶對我嚟講好珍貴。
items.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 wui4 jik1 deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 hou2 zan1 gwai3
items.meaning: This memory is very precious to me.

items.sentence: 每次回憶返以前嘅事，我都會笑。
items.jyutping: mui5 ci3 wui4 jik1 faan1 ji5 cin4 ge3 si6, ngo5 dou1 wui5 siu3
items.meaning: Every time I recall the past, I end up smiling.

items.sentence: 我試過食呢間餐廳。
items.jyutping: ngo5 si3 gwo3 sik6 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1
items.meaning: I’ve tried eating at this restaurant.

items.sentence: 佢未試過一個人住。
items.jyutping: keoi5 mei6 si3 gwo3 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6
items.meaning: He has never lived alone before.

items.sentence: 佢畀我嘅第一印象幾好。
items.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 ngo5 ge3 dai6 jat1 jan3 zoeng6 gei2 hou2
items.meaning: He gave me quite a good first impression.

items.sentence: 呢件事喺我心目中留下好深嘅印象。
items.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 hai2 ngo5 sam1 muk6 zung1 lau4 haa6 hou2 sam1 ge3 jan3 zoeng6
items.meaning: This matter left a very deep impression on me.

items.sentence: 親身經歷之後，我先真正體會到呢份工作嘅壓力。
items.jyutping: can1 san1 ging1 lik6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 sin1 zan1 zing3 tai2 wui6 dou3 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 ge3 aat3 lik6
items.meaning: Only after experiencing it firsthand did I truly realise the pressure of this job.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to personally realise / to deeply appreciate (through experience)

items.sentence: 慢慢做落去，你會體會到點解佢會咁講。
items.jyutping: maan6 maan6 zou6 lok6 heoi3, nei5 wui5 tai2 wui6 dou3 dim2 gaai2 keoi5 wui5 gam3 gong2
items.meaning: As you go along, you’ll come to realise why they said that.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to personally realise / to deeply appreciate (through experience)

items.sentence: 我直到而家先意識到自己犯咗個錯。
items.jyutping: ngo5 zik1 dou3 ji4 gaa1 sin1 ji3 sik1 dou3 zi6 gei2 faan6 zo2 go3 co3
items.meaning: I only realised just now that I made a mistake.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to realise / to become aware of

items.sentence: 佢慢慢意識到呢個問題冇想像中咁簡單。
items.jyutping: keoi5 maan6 maan6 ji3 sik1 dou3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 mou5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 gam3 gaan2 daan1
items.meaning: He gradually realised that this problem wasn’t as simple as imagined.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to realise / to become aware of

items.sentence: 呢條數學問題好難。
items.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 man6 tai4 hou2 naan4
items.meaning: This math problem is very hard.

items.sentence: 我哋要先解決呢個問題。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
items.meaning: We need to solve this problem first.

items.sentence: 你有咩問題可以問我。
items.jyutping: nei5 jau5 me1 man6 tai4 ho2 ji5 man6 ngo5
items.meaning: If you have any questions, you can ask me.

items.sentence: 佢哋之間有溝通問題。
items.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 kau1 tung1 man6 tai4
items.meaning: They have a communication problem.

items.sentence: 我哋會盡快處理呢個問題。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 zeon6 faai3 cyu2 lei5 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
items.meaning: We will handle this problem as soon as possible.

items.sentence: 呢件事已經處理好喇。
items.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 cyu2 lei5 hou2 laa3
items.meaning: This matter has already been dealt with.

items.sentence: 我哋需要時間去解決呢個問題。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 heoi3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
items.meaning: We need time to solve this problem.

items.sentence: 呢個方法未必可以解決所有困難。
items.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 mei6 bit1 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 so2 jau5 kwan3 naan4
items.meaning: This method may not be able to solve all difficulties.

items.sentence: 如果雙方都肯妥協，就比較容易解決問題。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 soeng1 fong1 dou1 hang2 to5 hip3, zau6 bei2 gaau3 jung4 ji6 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4
items.meaning: If both sides are willing to compromise, it’s easier to solve the problem.

items.sentence: 佢最後為咗關係，選擇咗妥協。
items.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 wai6 zo2 gwaan1 hai6, syun2 zaak6 zo2 to5 hip3
items.meaning: In the end, he chose to compromise for the sake of the relationship.

items.sentence: 我哋而家需要一個實際嘅解決方案。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 go3 sat6 zai3 ge3 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 on3
items.meaning: We now need a practical solution.

items.sentence: 佢提出咗一個唔錯嘅解決方案。
items.jyutping: keoi5 tai4 ceot1 zo2 jat1 go3 m4 co3 ge3 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 on3
items.meaning: He proposed a pretty good solution.

items.sentence: 計劃有改變。
items.jyutping: gai3 waak6 jau5 goi2 bin3
items.meaning: The plan has changed.

items.sentence: 你可以改變主意。
items.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3
items.meaning: You can change your mind.

items.sentence: 呢件事值得再諗一諗。
items.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 zi3 dak1 zoi3 nam2 jat1 nam2
items.meaning: This matter is worth thinking about again.

items.sentence: 呢次經驗好辛苦，但係好值得。
items.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ging1 jim6 hou2 san1 fu2, daan6 hai6 hou2 zi3 dak1
items.meaning: This experience was tough, but it was very worth it.

items.sentence: 呢個解釋聽落好合理。
items.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaai2 sik1 teng1 lok6 hou2 hap6 lei5
items.meaning: This explanation sounds reasonable.

items.sentence: 呢個要求唔算過份，其實都幾合理。
items.jyutping: ni1 go3 jiu1 kau4 m4 syun3 gwo3 fan6, kei4 sat6 dou1 gei2 hap6 lei5
items.meaning: This request isn’t excessive; it’s actually quite reasonable.

items.sentence: 佢哋之間嘅關係好密切。
items.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 mat6 cit3
items.meaning: Their relationship is very close.

items.sentence: 呢件事同我冇直接關係。
items.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 tung4 ngo5 mou5 zik6 zik1 gwaan1 hai6
items.meaning: This matter has no direct relationship with me.

items.sentence: 大家要好好溝通，先至解決到問題。
items.jyutping: daa6 gaa1 jiu3 hou2 hou2 kau1 tung1, sin1 zi3 gaai2 kyut3 dou3 man6 tai4
items.meaning: Everyone needs to communicate well in order to solve the problem.

items.sentence: 如果溝通唔清楚，好容易產生誤會。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 kau1 tung1 m4 cing1 co2, hou2 jung4 ji6 caan2 sang1 ng6 wui6
items.meaning: If communication isn’t clear, misunderstandings can easily arise.

items.sentence: 我同同事相處得幾好。
items.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 tung4 si6 soeng1 cyu2 dak1 gei2 hou2
items.meaning: I get along quite well with my colleagues.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to get along / to interact with

items.sentence: 同唔同人相處都需要耐性。
items.jyutping: tung4 m4 tung4 jan4 soeng1 cyu2 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 noi6 sing3
items.meaning: Getting along with different people all requires patience.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to get along / to interact with

items.sentence: 我哋需要同其他部門合作。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 tung4 kei4 taa1 bou6 mun4 hap6 zok3
items.meaning: We need to cooperate with other departments.

items.sentence: 如果大家合作，問題會更容易解決。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 daai6 gaa1 hap6 zok3, man6 tai4 wui5 gang3 jung4 ji5 gaai2 kyut3
items.meaning: If everyone cooperates, the problem will be easier to solve.

items.sentence: 我哋應該尊重彼此嘅意見。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 zeon1 zung6 bei2 ci2 ge3 ji3 gin3
items.meaning: We should respect each other’s opinions.

items.sentence: 尊重對方嘅選擇好重要。
items.jyutping: zeon1 zung6 deoi3 fong1 ge3 syun2 zaak6 hou2 zung6 jiu3
items.meaning: Respecting the other person’s choice is very important.

items.sentence: 相處最重要係互相包容。
items.jyutping: soeng1 cyu2 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 hai6 wu6 soeng1 baau1 jung4
items.meaning: The most important thing in getting along is mutual tolerance.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to tolerate / to be inclusive / to be accepting

items.sentence: 佢對人好包容，所以大家都幾尊重佢。
items.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 jan4 hou2 baau1 jung4, so2 ji5 daa6 gaa1 dou1 gei2 zeon1 zung6 keoi5
items.meaning: He’s very tolerant toward others, so everyone respects him.
items.sourceWordMeaning: to tolerate / to be inclusive / to be accepting

items.sentence: 原來佢已經搬走咗。
items.jyutping: jyun4 loi4 keoi5 ji5 ging1 bun1 zau2 zo2
items.meaning: It turns out he already moved away.

items.sentence: 我以為好難，原來冇想像中咁複雜。
items.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 wai4 hou2 naan4, jyun4 loi4 mou5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 gam3 fuk1 zaap6
items.meaning: I thought it was hard, but it turns out it’s not as complicated as I imagined.

items.sentence: 佢未必會嚟，今天天氣唔穩定。
items.jyutping: keoi5 mei6 bit1 wui5 lai4, gam1 tin1 tin1 hei3 m4 wan2 ding6.
items.meaning: He might not come; the weather is unstable today.

items.sentence: 做得咁快未必好，細心啲會好過。
items.jyutping: zou6 dak1 gam3 faai3 mei6 bit1 hou2, sai3 sam1 di1 wui5 hou2 gwo3.
items.meaning: Doing it so quickly is not necessarily good; being more careful would be better.

items.sentence: 呢件事未必只係佢一個人嘅錯。
items.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 mei6 bit1 zi2 hai6 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 ge3 co3.
items.meaning: This may not be just his fault alone.

items.sentence: 天氣預報講會落雨，但未必一定落。
items.jyutping: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 gong2 wui5 lok6 jyu5, daan6 mei6 bit1 jat1 ding6 lok6.
items.meaning: The weather forecast says it will rain, but it may not actually rain.

items.sentence: 你小心啲行，地下好滑。
items.jyutping: nei5 siu2 sam1 di1 haang4, dei6 haa6 hou2 waat6
items.meaning: Walk carefully, the floor is very slippery.

items.sentence: 同佢講嘢小心啲，佢而家心情唔好。
items.jyutping: tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5 siu2 sam1 di1, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 sam1 cing4 m4 hou2
items.meaning: Speak to them a bit more gently; they’re not in a good mood right now.

items.sentence: 今日可能會落雨。
items.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 jyu5
items.meaning: It might rain today.

items.sentence: 佢可能未準備好，所以仲未回覆。
items.jyutping: keoi5 ho2 nang4 mei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2, so2 ji5 zung6 mei6 wui4 fuk6
items.meaning: He might not be ready yet, so he hasn’t replied.

items.sentence: 呢兩個方案之間冇乜差別。
items.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 fong1 on3 zi1 gaan1 mou5 mat1 caa1 bit6
items.meaning: There isn’t much difference between these two options.

items.sentence: 價錢嘅差別會影響選擇。
items.jyutping: gaa3 cin2 ge3 caa1 bit6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 syun2 zaak6
items.meaning: The price difference will affect the choice.

items.sentence: 呢兩個界別之間有好明顯嘅分別。
items.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 gaai3 bit6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 hou2 ming4 hin2 ge3 fan1 bit6
items.meaning: There is a very clear distinction between these two categories.

items.sentence: 佢對唔同界別嘅睇法都幾清楚。
items.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 m4 tung4 gaai3 bit6 ge3 tai2 faat3 dou1 gei2 cing1 co2
items.meaning: He has quite a clear view of different sectors.

items.sentence: 大家對佢嘅表現都有唔同嘅評價。
items.jyutping: daa6 gaa1 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin6 dou1 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 ping4 gaa3
items.meaning: Everyone has different evaluations of his performance.

items.sentence: 呢個方案暫時好難評價成效。
items.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 zaam6 si4 hou2 naan4 ping4 gaa3 sing4 haau6
items.meaning: It’s hard to evaluate the effectiveness of this plan for now.
